lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਬਿਸਾਰਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: apane sevak kau kabahu na bisaarahu ||
lines.translation: Never forget Your servant, O Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਰਿ ਲਾਗਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਪੂਰਬ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਬੀਚਾਰਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ur laagahu suaamee prabh mere poorab preet gobi(n)d beechaarahu ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Hug me close in Your embrace, O God, my Lord and Master; consider my primal love for You, O Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੋ ਹਮਰੇ ਦੋਖ ਰਿਦੈ ਮਤ ਧਾਰਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: patit paavan prabh birad tumhaaro hamare dokh ridai mat dhaarahu ||
lines.translation: It is Your Natural Way, God, to purify sinners; please do not keep my errors in Your Heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਟਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਰਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jeevan praan har dhan sukh tum hee haumai patal kripaa kar jaarahu ||1||
lines.translation: You are my life, my breath of life, O Lord, my wealth and peace; be merciful to me, and burn away the curtain of egotism. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਮੀਨ ਕਤ ਜੀਵਨ ਦੂਧ ਬਿਨਾ ਰਹਨੁ ਕਤ ਬਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal bihoon meen kat jeevan doodh binaa rahan kat baaro ||
lines.translation: Without water, how can the fish survive? Without milk, how can the baby survive?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਆਸ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲਨੑ ਕੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੋ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੨੩॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak piaas charan kamalanh kee pekh daras suaamee sukh saaro ||2||7||123||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak thirsts for the Lord's Lotus Feet; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of his Lord and Master's Darshan, he finds the essence of peace. ||2||7||123||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aagai paachhai kusal bhaiaa ||
lines.translation: Here, and hereafter, there is happiness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰੀ ਸਭ ਰਾਖੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਮਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur poorai pooree sabh raakhee paarabraham prabh keenee maiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Perfect Guru has perfectly, totally saved me; the Supreme Lord God has been kind to me. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਸਗਲਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan rav rahiaa har preetam dookh darad sagalaa mit gaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord, my Beloved, is pervading and permeating my mind and body; all my pains and sufferings are dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਆਨਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਟ ਸਭਿ ਹੋਏ ਖਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: saa(n)t sahaj aanad gun gaae doot dusat sabh hoe khaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: In celestial peace, tranquility and bliss, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; my enemies and adversaries have been totally destroyed. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਨੁ ਅਵਗੁਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun avagun prabh kachh na beechaario kar kirapaa apunaa kar laiaa ||
lines.translation: God has not considered my merits and demerits; in His Mercy, He has made me His own.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਤੁਲ ਬਡਾਈ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਉਚਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਜਇਆ ॥੨॥੮॥੧੨੪॥
lines.transliteration: atul badaaee achut abinaasee naanak ucharai har kee jaiaa ||2||8||124||
lines.translation: Unweighable is the greatness of the immovable and imperishable Lord; Nanak proclaims the victory of the Lord. ||2||8||124||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਭੈ ਭਗਤੀ ਤਰਨੁ ਕੈਸੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin bhai bhagatee taran kaise ||
lines.translation: Without the Fear of God, and devotional worship, how can anyone cross over the world-ocean?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਹੁ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਰਾਖੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਪ ਭਰੋਸੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: karahu anugrahu patit udhaaran raakh suaamee aap bharose ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Be kind to me, O Saving Grace of sinners; preserve my faith in You, O my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਵਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਮਦ ਮਾਵਤ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਾਤਾ ਸੁਆਨ ਜੈਸੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: simaran nahee aavat phirat mad maavat bikhiaa raataa suaan jaise ||
lines.translation: The mortal does not remember the Lord in meditation; he wanders around intoxicated by egotism; he is engrossed in corruption like a dog.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਉਧ ਬਿਹਾਵਤ ਅਧਿਕ ਮੋਹਾਵਤ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਵਤ ਬੁਡੇ ਐਸੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: audh bihaavat adhik mohaavat paap kamaavat bude aise ||1||
lines.translation: Utterly cheated, his life is slipping away; committing sins, he is sinking away. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਵਣੁ ਜੈਸੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saran dukh bha(n)jan purakh nira(n)jan saadhoo sa(n)gat ravan jaise ||
lines.translation: I have come to Your Sanctuary, Destroyer of pain; O Primal Immaculate Lord, may I dwell upon You in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਸਵ ਕਲੇਸ ਨਾਸ ਅਘ ਖੰਡਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵਤ ਦਰਸ ਦਿਸੇ ॥੨॥੯॥੧੨੫॥
lines.transliteration: kesav kales naas agh kha(n)dan naanak jeevat daras dise ||2||9||125||
lines.translation: O Lord of beautiful hair, Destroyer of pain, Eradicator of sins, Nanak lives, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||2||9||125||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੯ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 5 dupade ghar 9 ||
lines.translation: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Dho-Padhay, Ninth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਹਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapahi mel lae ||
lines.translation: He Himself merges us with Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਆਏ ਤਬ ਤੇ ਦੋਖ ਗਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab te saran tumaaree aae tab te dokh gae ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: When I came to Your Sanctuary, my sins vanished. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਅਰੁ ਚਿੰਤ ਬਿਰਾਨੀ ਸਾਧਹ ਸਰਨ ਪਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: taj abhimaan ar chi(n)t biraanee saadhah saran pae ||
lines.translation: Renouncing egotistical pride and other anxieties, I have sought the Sanctuary of the Holy Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਰੋਗ ਖਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jap jap naam tumhaaro preetam tan te rog khae ||1||
lines.translation: Chanting, meditating on Your Name, O my Beloved, disease is eradicated from my body. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਜਾਨ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਰਾਖੇ ਧਾਰਿ ਦਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa mugadh ajaan agiaanee raakhe dhaar dae ||
lines.translation: Even utterly foolish, ignorant and thoughtless persons have been saved by the Kind Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨ ਰਹੇ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੨੬॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak gur pooraa bhetio aavan jaan rahe ||2||1||126||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, I have met the Perfect Guru; my comings and goings have ended. ||2||1||126||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeevau naam sunee ||
lines.translation: Hearing Your Name, I live.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤਬ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪੁਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jau suprasa(n)n bhae gur poore tab meree aas punee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: When the Perfect Guru became pleased with me, then my hopes were fulfilled. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੀਰ ਗਈ ਬਾਧੀ ਮਨਿ ਧੀਰਾ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਅਨਦ ਧੁਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: peer gaee baadhee man dheeraa mohio anad dhunee ||
lines.translation: Pain is gone, and my mind is comforted; the music of bliss fascinates me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਪਜਿਓ ਚਾਉ ਮਿਲਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਖਿਨੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: upajio chaau milan prabh preetam rahan na jaai khinee ||1||
lines.translation: The yearning to meet my Beloved God has welled up within me. I cannot live without Him, even for an instant. ||1||
